articles.title: Harbor City approves electric bus order
articles.text: Harbor City's council approved an order for 120 electric buses on Tuesday. The city will spend $18 million from an existing transport fund, with no increase in fares planned. Deliveries are scheduled to begin in March 2027 and finish by December 2027. The buses will replace aging diesel vehicles on six routes. Officials said the order could reduce fleet emissions, but the city has not published an emissions estimate. The depot charging contract is still under review, so the delivery schedule remains conditional on that contract being completed.

articles.title: Ocho bibliotecas amplían su horario durante un piloto
articles.text: Ocho bibliotecas de Puerto Claro abrirán los domingos durante un programa piloto de tres meses. El piloto comenzará el 4 de octubre de 2026 y tendrá un presupuesto de 240.000 euros. El acceso seguirá siendo gratuito. El ayuntamiento evaluará la asistencia y los costes antes de decidir si mantiene el nuevo horario. No se ha aprobado una ampliación permanente ni se han anunciado cambios para las otras doce bibliotecas de la ciudad.

articles.title: Water utility reports early leak-detection results
articles.text: Clearwater Utilities reported that a six-month sensor pilot detected 43 underground leaks across two districts. Water loss in those districts was 12% lower than in the same months last year. The utility cautioned that rainfall and repair staffing also changed, so the figures do not establish that the sensors alone caused the reduction. The trial cost $900,000. An independent review is expected in November 2026. The utility has not decided whether to expand the system citywide.
